scenario: Six symposium talks — Farida, Gómez, Hartley, Inoue, Jansen, and Kwon — are scheduled one per slot in six consecutive time slots numbered 1 through 6. Each talk is assigned to exactly one of two tracks: the Red track or the Blue track. The following conditions apply:

rules.description: Farida is scheduled in an earlier slot than Gómez.
Inoue is scheduled in an earlier slot than Jansen.
Hartley and Kwon are not scheduled in consecutively numbered slots.
Farida and Hartley are both assigned to the Red track.
Gómez and Jansen are assigned to different tracks.
If Inoue is in slot 3, then both Inoue and Kwon are assigned to the Blue track.

explanations.B: Correct. By Rule 5, Gómez and Jansen must always be on different tracks. If Gómez is Blue, Jansen is necessarily Red — this holds in every valid solution with Gómez on the Blue track.
explanations.C: Kwon's track is not determined solely by Gómez's track. Kwon is forced to the Blue track only when Inoue occupies slot 3 (conditional Rule 6); otherwise Kwon can be on either track.
explanations.D: Inoue's slot position is not fixed when Gómez is on the Blue track. Inoue only needs to be scheduled before Jansen, which allows Inoue in many different slots.
